Table: categories
Columns: category_id (INTEGER), category_name (VARCHAR(100))
Primary Keys: category_id
Foreign Key Relationships:
 No foreign keys.

Table: products
Columns: product_id (INTEGER), name (VARCHAR(150)), price (NUMERIC(10, 2)), category_id (INTEGER)
Primary Keys: product_id
Foreign Key Relationships:

category_id references categories.category_id

Table: customers
Columns: customer_id (INTEGER), name (VARCHAR(100)), city (VARCHAR(100)), email (VARCHAR(150))
Primary Keys: customer_id
Foreign Key Relationships:
 No foreign keys.

Table: orders
Columns: order_id (INTEGER), customer_id (INTEGER), order_date (DATE), status (VARCHAR(30))
Primary Keys: order_id
Foreign Key Relationships:

customer_id references customers.customer_id

Table: order_items
Columns: item_id (INTEGER), order_id (INTEGER), product_id (INTEGER), quantity (INTEGER)
Primary Keys: item_id
Foreign Key Relationships:

order_id references orders.order_id
product_id references products.product_id

Table: payments
Columns: payment_id (INTEGER), order_id (INTEGER), amount (NUMERIC(10, 2)), payment_status (VARCHAR(30))
Primary Keys: payment_id
Foreign Key Relationships:

order_id references orders.order_id
